sourcePolicy: Local working tree, tests, diagnostics, scripts, RefPlan5, local Git history and the Phase 09 exact package runtime only; no remote Git.

phaseGate.input: Verified Phase 09 pinned validated-module importer and Phase 06/07/08 Canonical IR, value-flow, target-machine and target-platform contracts.
phaseGate.output: One explicit Phase 10 policy over the existing importer that creates an immutable handle-free semantic snapshot, table-driven lossless/reject mapping, Canonical IR virtual values and frontend-neutral analysis evidence.
phaseGate.authorityBoundary: LLVM may provide validated source semantics and provenance. Core revalidates Canonical IR, virtual-value dependencies, target capabilities and evidence. LLVM has no scheduling, W=8 placement, backend, runtime legality, publication, commit or retire authority.
phaseGate.deterministicFallback: Only no-argument void, single-basic-block integer add/sub/mul plus ret primitives are admitted. Every unqualified type/opcode/attribute/intrinsic/memory/metadata/CFG/analysis construct rejects deterministically before scheduling; no helper is selected implicitly.

semanticMappingContract.losslessActiveSubset: i8/i16/i32/i64 add/sub/mul with exact wrap or source-poison flags; one no-argument void function; one basic block; ret void; llvm.ident provenance
semanticMappingContract.unsupportedExamples: floating/pointer lowering, PHI/select, multi-block CFG, calls, loads/stores, volatile/atomic/fence, casts/GEP, undef/poison/freeze materialization, semantic attributes, intrinsics, debug/analysis metadata

releaseDisposition.defaultEnabledScope: Phase 10 semantic mapping is explicit-only inside the optional LLVM adapter; native compilation remains byte-for-byte on its existing path.
releaseDisposition.releaseDisposition: Qualified as the Phase 11 prerequisite. LLVM optimization, backend emission and final release authorization remain disabled.

nextDependencyGate.gate: Define an exact deterministic default-off LLVM optimization recipe with pre/post verification and Phase 10 remapping; invalidate pre-transform facts after CFG/memory/value changes and prove zero native-profile dependency or codegen delta.
